items.description: Le gouvernement va transmettre le jeudi 1er octobre son projet de loi de finance 2027 à l'Assemblée nationale. Objectif 2027 : réduire le déficit à 5% du PIB via deux leviers : baisse des dépenses et hausse des recettes. Parmi les premières pistes évoquées, le gel du point d'indice des salaires des fonctionnaires, une contribution plus importantes des personnes à la retraite et la suppression de niches fiscales "inefficaces" pour éviter d'avoir à augmenter les impôts en cette année électorale.

Le souverain pontife a décollé en fin de journée pour Rome.

El Niño met l'océan Pacifique en surchauffe et provoque de fortes précipitations ou des sécheresses selon les régions du monde. items.description: En Turquie, un tribunal d’Istanbul a condamné, ce lundi 28 septembre, le célèbre humoriste Deniz Göktas à un peu plus de 19 mois de prison. items.title: Natural draft cooling tower is preferred JEK2 option
items.summary: A feasibility study of four cooling tower options for Slovenia's proposed JEK2 new nuclear project has proposed a natural draft cooling tower of between 193 metres and 198 metres.
items.description: A feasibility study of four cooling tower options for Slovenia's proposed JEK2 new nuclear project has proposed a natural draft cooling tower of between 193 metres and 198 metres.

items.title: Third unit at Changjiang site commissioned
items.summary: Unit 3 of the Changjiang nuclear power plant in China's island province of Hainan has entered commercial operation. The unit is the first of two Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors being constructed as Phase II of the plant.

items.title: UK nuclear regulators set out plans to implement reforms
items.summary: The Office for Nuclear Regulation and the Environment Agency have informed ministers of the changes they have already made or intend to make in order to speed up the licensing process for new nuclear technologies and construction projects.

items.title: Holtec postpones planned stock market launch
items.summary: Holtec Nuclear Corporation is postponing the initial public offering it announced in July, due to market conditions. The company's CEO has said market concerns about the AI sector have played a part in the decision.

items.title: First transfer from Chernobyl's new waste processing facility
items.summary: Seven packages containing low- and intermediate-level radioactive waste have been shipped after processing from the Industrial Complex for Solid Radioactive Waste Management.

items.title: Smolensk's planned new units get environmental approval
items.summary: The licence justification materials for two new units at the next phase of Smolensk Nuclear Power Plant in Russia have had a positive verdict from Russia's State Environmental Expertise.

items.title: Podcast - Norman Foster's symposium speech on nuclear energy
items.summary: Internationally-renowned architect Lord Norman Foster was one of the key speakers at World Nuclear Symposium in London. items.description: Internationally-renowned architect Lord Norman Foster was one of the key speakers at World Nuclear Symposium in London. In his speech he said that nuclear's ability to provide a "vast amount of power" with "a tiny imprint" means that micro-modular power units should be being produced at "industrial-scale, like jet engines" with the potential to autonomously power new developments and move beyond the "obsolete idea of a grid".

items.title: Cameco in offtake agreement for US laser enrichment plant
items.summary: Canadian company Cameco Corporation is to buy all of the future production of GLE's planned Paducah Laser Enrichment Facility in Kentucky under a newly announced exclusive offtake agreement.

items.title: Blue Energy submits first construction application to NRC
items.summary: Blue Energy has submitted the first part of its construction permit application to the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission for its planned gas-to-nuclear project in Texas.

items.title: Holtec SMR project gets regulatory nod for early site work
items.summary: An exemption granted by the US regulator means Holtec can go ahead with certain works before the issuance of a Limited Work Authorisation for two small modular reactor units at the Palisades Energy Center in Michigan.
